name: Identity Number Ranges
tagline: The second half of a survivor's designation carries her sentence.
body: Read a survivor ID as flight-then-range. Evie's 00-100 is the sharpest example the canon has: Flight 0, and the lowest number in the marked-dangers band.
rules: 000–099 — obedient, quiet, or broken survivors; sometimes promoted
100–199 — marked dangers, watched constantly; closer to 100 means higher threat
200–299 — Pleasure Designate Pool; sexual or appearance-based reconditioning
300–399 — Enforcer Designate Pool; groomed for brutality and control
